== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Diamond Veins are a valuable asset that can be earned through points, a process that [[Lindon]] found took longer than anticipated due to the costs of supporting others. Once acquired, they can be absorbed to improve an individual's [[madra channels]] and strengthen the connection between their body and [[spirit]]. For [[Yerin]], these veins provided essential stability for her [[madra channels]] during the use of a specific [[technique]] that would otherwise have caused them to rupture. Additionally, copies of these veins can be used to progress a person's physical solidity and strengthen their [[spirit]] well.}}
